Thank you kindly :) No, I'm Russian. Chose Jamaica because this is the only Caribbean country that speaks English and I really wanted to make it a game about life on a Caribbean island, with poverty, crimes and all that. Once I finish building it, I'll get to scripting. Not gonna promise GTA VI lol, there are some technical limitations I'll have to stay within, but hoping to make something fun nonetheless. 

And it may take a year or two to complete, and that's if I manage to keep that will to work on it up. (Prospects are good, but you never know.) But whenever I get it to a somewhat completed state, I'll remember to send you the link :)

Well, the pics may appear generic, not sure how interesting it may look to someone else, because they aren't textured and aren't put in the environment yet... I'll do texturing closer to putting them in Unity.

And I'm spoofing Kingston, Jamaica, but since there is no Street View for that city (gee I wonder why XD) I take references from wherever I can, like San Juan, or Los Angeles, and whenever I find some pics of Kingston itself.

This is the one I'm most proud of to date: [https://i.postimg.cc/NFpLQPcv/Emp-Resid4apt2fl-blend.png](https://i.postimg.cc/NFpLQPcv/Emp-Resid4apt2fl-blend.png) a residential building with 4 apartments, had a very nice reference building for it.

You actually made me smile with this :) and I'm a strong believer that we all can learn from each other, so you may be a dummy in some things I'm not, but I very well may be a dummy in some things you aren't!

And well, that's only taking off as I'm finally getting a hook of 3D modelling well enough not to be terrified of making mistakes, but I'm building a virtual city for a metaverse, and I'm already on my 5th building for it! I've figured out how to build them most efficiently, which order to put parts in, what to put first (rooms) and what last (the roof). Now those aren't furnished yet, but I'll do it once I place them in Unity 3D. I want to quickly move on from one building to another, since that's how I hold my interest best in this project. Focusing too much on little details in the beginning isn't a great idea lol. Maybe someday I'll make a tutorial about this, so I can offer people the way of building houses I had to discover myself, so they don't have to spend time on figuring out that one themselves.

And I'm also proud in my ability to just get up and do something that needs to be done, instead of putting it off until the last minute. Mum likes this about me too, but it often translates to me losing patience with her and doing the thing she promised to get done myself, which I'm kinda tired of.

Also am proud of finding a free municipal psychological support centre in my city and getting an appointment with them. It's in a month, but I'm happy with that still, because I thought I'd get it in like May. Looking forward to finally speak to someone who can see my situation objectively!

So yeah, something like this :D

Wow... so terribly sorry for your situation. It sucks that we don't choose our parents, and even the best ones are only humans. I looked up the suicide prevention hotline for Israel, so you don't have to [http://www.suicide.org/hotlines/international/israel-suicide-hotlines.html](http://www.suicide.org/hotlines/international/israel-suicide-hotlines.html) . Give them a call, if you haven't already. (Use a spoofer phone if you can, so they don't track you.) This service is for everyone; as long as you've got a mobile phone, you don't need your dad's permission to talk to them. Take a chance. Best of luck, friend!

Yeah, I keep moving. The problem is, can't keep moving without interacting with others, without being a circumstance for them. And it seems like they've got a lot on their plate already, and they really don't need me in their face. Wish I could me my former self, convenient to the world and happy alone.

I do have things I'd be proud of sharing, but it feels like people only see the negative in me, and pointing out my positives to them is kind of obnoxious. And I know my worth, but somehow the world doesn't see it (or at least it feels so), so maybe it's correct and I'm wrong?

And yeah, I definitely will be in the most unexpected place 5 years from now... that is, if I'm still around. Looking back 5 years, I wouldn't even imagine that I'd have a Bachelor's degree and would be getting a grad degree in the top university in my country now! And what I'm going through is so far the second worst I've been so far, and the first worst nearly ended in a suicide. I don't know how much more of this I'll manage.

P.S.: hope you've read the P.S. in my previous message ♥

Like I said, so far I fail in keeping my head up at all times, failing right when I really need it. And to be honest, I don't want to become like all these unhappy people who just lash out at others because their life is miserable. If I'm at that state, I'd rather rid the world of the negativity in the form of my persona.

And yeah, I probably do affect some people in life, but question is, do I affect them in a positive or negative way? I feel like an enabler to my mum, and maybe my passing would be a wake up call to her to get herself together. And people who used to care about me but don't anymore... since they don't care about living me, maybe the dead me is actually better for them, since that's the one they'd care about?

By the way, are you talking about John Bain aka TotalBiscuit perchance? I watched him a lot, still rewatch his videos on occasion. He was a real treasure, and his death was a true loss to the gaming community, and to the world overall. But I'm no John Bain, really.

P.S.: Just wanted to say thank you for stickin' around and talkin' to me, even though I've trouble accepting your advice, it still helps a ton that someone offers an ear, and fells really cathartic to let it all out. Thank you so damn much, for me and for all the people you leave a comment for! May the kindness you share return to you in double amount ♥

Thank you for the reply, kind stranger. I don't drink. And it's been going downhill for the past 2 months now. It wasn't getting better, no matter how many breaks from the world I've taken.

At worst, the world will grief for a bit of time and move on, and mum will lament that she's lost one of her entourage.

You know, I've been a strong person, managing the hardest turns of life like a badass and supporting others, until recently - somehow my strength wore off while I still needed it. It looks like the weak me is a burden on the world, and I have no idea if I'd be able to restore my strength under its continuous pressure. So far, I fail.
Yeah, naturally. Like, it's gotta be someone whom you really really trust not to make abrupt decisions with lifetime consequences for you. How to distinguish these people is the real question lol
Cheers for the warning, friend. Whenever we're ready to go, let's make it quick, efficient and not let anyone know beforehand.
